name: Major JNPT / Nhava Sheva Port Congestion & Dwell Spike
description: Severe container backlog and berth congestion across Maharashtra/Gujarat gateway ports with 21-day vessel dwell delay.

name: Global Crude Oil Surge ($120/bbl) & INR Depreciation
description: Geopolitical escalation driving Brent crude to $120/bbl and USD/INR to ₹89.5, impacting domestic diesel freight and import landed cost.

name: Monsoon Flooding in Western Dedicated Freight & NH48 Corridor
description: Unprecedented monsoon cloudburst causing submerged highway stretches on NH48 and mudslides along Western Ghats connecting Mumbai to Pune and Bengaluru.

name: Electronics & Semiconductor Import Tariff Hike (Customs Shock)
description: Revised DGFT import duty hike on integrated circuits, bare PCBs, and passive components, combined with prolonged customs clearance audits.

name: Global Container Shortage & Red Sea Cape Rerouting
description: Container equipment unavailability and vessel circumnavigation via Cape of Good Hope, doubling transit times and doubling ocean freight rates.
